findings.issue: Three declarations depend on no central-simple theory and are stated at full generality, yet are only reachable by importing the whole central-simple chain: `exists_isMulCommutative_forall_finrank_le` (line 133) and `centralizer_eq_self_of_forall_finrank_le` (line 160) need only `[Ring A] [Algebra K A] [FiniteDimensional K A]` plus the subalgebra lattice, and `isField_of_isMulCommutative` (line 190) needs only `[Ring D] [IsDomain D]` and `IsArtinianRing`.

summary: The new file sits in the right subdirectory with clean imports, but two groups of declarations are in the wrong home: the general subfield-centralizer dimension formula belongs next to its sibling in Centralizer.lean, and three lemmas that use no central-simple theory at all belong in an earlier subalgebra file.
